summary: Iteration 43 tested end-to-end: (a) backend GET /api/products/{id}/bundle, (b) product-page + course-page bundle upsell UI and add-to-cart with 15% discount, (c) Spanish toggle across all marketing homepage sections + free-class expanded modal, (d) asana play-badge (verified positively by temporarily setting a clip via admin API, then reverting). 9/9 backend tests pass; all requested frontend flows pass. No blocking defects. Payments/emails were NOT triggered (stopped at 'Continue to shipping'; free-class form never submitted).

minor.issue: Unknown/misspelled fields (e.g. youtube_id, clip_start) are silently dropped and the endpoint still returns 200 with an unchanged doc — no 422. Makes admin mistakes invisible.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal cannot be closed with the Escape key (only the X button / overlay click). Minor a11y gap; also blocks header clicks while open.

issues: All card copy is hardcoded English ('Complete your practice', 'Add the mat + book & save 15%', 'Save $17.55', 'Add bundle to cart'). In ES mode the card stays English — inconsistent with the 'finish Spanish' goal.
Program difficulty chips still render English 'BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / ADVANCED'
Section eyebrow 'PRACTICE IN MOTION' remains English
Page copy (title 'Asana Index', description, search placeholder, category chips) is untranslated while the bottom nav is Spanish — mixed-language screen

action_items: i18n: move BundleOffer card strings into en/es locales so the bundle upsell translates.
i18n leftovers on homepage in ES: difficulty chips (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) and the 'Practice in motion' eyebrow; /asanas page copy still English.
Add Escape-key close to the free-class expanded modal.
Optional: make PATCH /api/admin/asanas reject unknown fields (422) instead of silently ignoring them.
critical_code_review_comments: BundleOffer.jsx computes savings/bundle price client-side; the cart discount is recomputed from cart.setPromo pct — server-side validation of the promo pct at checkout should be confirmed so a tampered localStorage promo cannot inflate the discount.
product_bundle() returns the first matching program; if a product ever belongs to two course bundles the chosen discount is non-deterministic (iteration order of db.programs.find).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Temporarily set a YouTube clip on the first seeded asana (Half Moon Pose) to verify the play badge; reverted youtube_url/cover_image/start/end and asserted revert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: /api/products/{id}/bundle returns bundle for mat (dc749b67...) and journal (84e6e494...) with program 7585a2ef..., 15%, 2 physical products totalling $117; the other 2 products (Tee, Cork Blocks) return bundle:null and their /shop pages show no bundle-upsell. Product-page bundle-add and course-page bundle-add both add mat+journal, navigate to /cart, show cart-discount-row '15% bundle discount −$17.55' and cart-subtotal $99.45 (stopped at 'Continue to shipping'). Spanish toggle verified on desktop viewport ONLY — data-testid lang-es/lang-en are hidden inside the hamburger on 390px mobile, so use 1920x1080 for language tests. Watch out: inner_text returns UPPERCASE for .eyebrow elements (CSS text-transform), so compare case-insensitively; EN strings are 'Personalised. Progressive. Sustainable.' and 'Students, past & present'. The free-class modal overlay (z-70) intercepts header clicks — close it before clicking the lang pill. ES selection persists in localStorage key ty_lang across reloads.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional failures reproduced. Two earlier apparent failures were test-side: (1) Testimonials eyebrow 'mismatch' was CSS uppercase transform; (2) asana clip PATCH 'not persisting' was due to using youtube_id/clip_start instead of the API contract fields youtube_url/start_seconds/end_seconds.
